when_used: A proprietor grants an easement or analogous right over the servient land in favour of the dominant land, for a period and on conditions.

detail_rows.label: land or specific part burdened by the easem

body_text.text: (receipt whereof is hereby acknowledged by the Grantor) the Grantor HEREBY GRANTS to the Grantee an Easement/analogous right over the above Title in the nature for the period and subject to the conditions stated above.
WITNESS WHEREOF this grant of easement has been duly executed by the parties herein.

custom_fields.name: consideration
custom_fields.label: Consideration for the grant
custom_fields.prompt: What the grantee gives for the easement, in words and figures

custom_fields.name: nature_of_easement
custom_fields.label: Nature of the easement or analogous right granted
custom_fields.prompt: What the easement allows, for example a right of way on foot and with vehicles over the access road

custom_fields.name: conditions
custom_fields.label: Conditions
custom_fields.prompt: The conditions the easement is granted subject to

custom_fields.name: period_of_easement
custom_fields.label: Period of the easement
custom_fields.prompt: How long the easement runs for, for example in perpetuity or for twenty years from 1st October 2026

custom_fields.name: servient_land
custom_fields.label: Land or specific part burdened by the easement
custom_fields.prompt: The servient land, or the specific part of it, that the easement burdens

custom_fields.name: dominant_land
custom_fields.label: Dominant land
custom_fields.prompt: The land that takes the benefit of the easement, by title number and location
